_doc: Room rules for lab rooms (Movement Lab online, Range Lab). Field names follow research/core_mechanics.md §11's recommendation. Siege's Action Phase has team damage on and Prep Phase off (§11). Reverse friendly fire is implemented but off here, so two-browser tests don't trip it; `lastAliveDies` is off because a lab has no rounds. `dummyRespawnS` is our lab setting, not a Siege value.
